findings.passage: Today’s proposal would enshrine Wisconsin’s restrictive voter ID law into the state constitution, making it almost impossible for eligible voters whose rights are violated to seek redress in court.
findings.note: Press release in her name (posted by Urban Milwaukee, which carries no date on the page; the content concerns the Senate's voter ID constitutional amendment, which took place in January 2025). She describes the amendment as writing the voter ID law into the constitution and limiting court challenges.

findings.passage: But rather than tackle any of these important issues, Republican politicians are back to their tired playbook – cynical partisan power grabs to rig the system so they can keep power, this time by putting anti-voter measures in our state constitution.
findings.note: Same release. She calls the voter ID amendment an anti-voter measure and objects to putting it in the constitution.
